note: Private RV park south of Louisburg with a Western-themed outpost store (propane, U-Haul, self and RV storage on the same lot), a small catch-and-release fishing pond, a storm shelter, and Middle Creek State Fishing Lake nearby. A mix of overnighters and long-term guests (monthly rates exclude electricity; no limit on long stays). --Claude
summary: Operator site confirms $45 back-in / $50 pull-through daily (matches stored Campspot fees), 83 full-hookup sites, showers/laundry, open year round, Campspot booking; added count, season, booking, flush_toilets. Pond under 1 acre, not waterfront. Pin ~150 m west of the sites.

Website: stored 'http://www.rutladeroutpost.com/' + 'https://www.campspot.com/park/rutlader-outpost-rv-park'. Suggest 'https://www.rutladeroutpost.com/' + 'https://www.campspot.com/book/rutladeroutpost' (the booking link the operator publishes on its About page). Phone 913-377-2722 confirmed.

US$50 gate: base $45 (full-hookup back-in, the operator's rv-park page and Campspot agree; weekly $290/$315). Campspot adds a $7.00 online booking fee per stay, so ONE night booked online is $52; two nights $48.50 a night. Booking by phone may avoid it (not stated). No gateway: Kansas City is ~65 km away (over 40 km). The 2026-10-15 re-check passed it at $45-50 + $7; AWH may want to rule on whether a per-stay online booking fee counts toward the gate.

Long-stay tests: (1) $45 base, see the fee question above; (2) nights sold on Campspot and by phone, no application for a nightly stay (the RV-photo/inquiry step is for long-term stays only); (3) no minimum stated; (4) no count of nightly vs long-term sites published: pass; (5) not a home community (RV sites, storage and commercial space; no homes or lots sold). Passes. Imagery shows the RV area densely filled, partly RV storage the park also sells.
Waterfront (stored not waterfront): CONFIRMED. The on-site fishing pond is ~60 m across (under 1 acre) south of the RV area; Middle Creek State Fishing Lake is off-site.
